label: Cube-free quotients and kernels
subgoals: Check whether any literal appears in every cube
Divide F by candidate cubes and keep the cube-free quotients
Count F itself as a kernel when it is cube-free

label: Enumerating kernels and co-kernels
subgoals: Divide by each literal that appears in two or more cubes
Strip the largest common cube to make each quotient cube-free
Record each kernel with every co-kernel that produces it

label: Levels and the intersection theorem
subgoals: Test each kernel for kernels other than itself
Classify the kernels without proper kernels as level 0
Use kernel intersections of two cubes or more to find common divisors
